scope.description: Mapped polygons associated through existing atlas map IDs entity-mongolia in the 1930 boundary snapshot. This measures the displayed mapped extent, not an official contemporary statistic or all territory claimed by the polity.

evidence.note: WGS84 ellipsoidal geodesic polygon area, holes subtracted, exact duplicate/overlap union, antimeridian longitude unwrapping, three significant digits. No geometry repair, historical ownership or official statistical assertion. Raw computed area 1576966.2588294174 km2; 1 source features. pyproj 3.7.2; Shapely 2.1.2. Derived from the actual boundary snapshot, not a population statistical geography.

qualifications: Derived mapped/geometric area, not an official contemporary historical area statistic.
Approximate historical polygons; three significant digits. Holes subtracted and overlapping mapped pieces counted once.
Boundary snapshot year is the geometry observation date. No continuous territorial validity is inferred between snapshots.
